name: ft-authz-negative-mod
description: R210 P2 (security plan section 2 / section 5): a signed-in MEMBER hits each of the 9 moderation doors. Jordan Lee (u_me, plain member, the real scrypt door) signs in, then probes every /api/moderation/* route in-page with credentials: the 6 GET doors by plain XHR, the 3 POST-only doors (escalations / mute / refer) with a freshly minted CSRF token so the ROLE gate answers, not the CSRF gate. Every door must refuse with 403 and the gate's own sentence.

steps.name: door-1-activity-403
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/activity', false); x.send(); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()

steps.name: door-2-campaign-review-403
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/campaign-review', false); x.send(); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()

steps.name: door-3-escalations-403-with-csrf
steps.expr: (() => { const c = new XMLHttpRequest(); c.open('GET', '/api/auth/csrf', false); c.send(); const t = (JSON.parse(c.responseText) || {}).csrfToken || ''; const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '/api/moderation/escalations', false); x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); x.setRequestHeader('X-CSRF-Token', t); x.send(JSON.stringify({ action: 'resolve', escalationId: 'e_r210' })); return 'csrf=' + (t ? 'ok' : 'none') + ' status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()

steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/listing-review', false); x.send(); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()

steps.name: door-5-mute-403-with-csrf
steps.expr: (() => { const c = new XMLHttpRequest(); c.open('GET', '/api/auth/csrf', false); c.send(); const t = (JSON.parse(c.responseText) || {}).csrfToken || ''; const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '/api/moderation/mute', false); x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); x.setRequestHeader('X-CSRF-Token', t); x.send(JSON.stringify({ userId: 'u_seller1', mute: true, reason: 'r210 negative walk: the member leg must refuse' })); return 'csrf=' + (t ? 'ok' : 'none') + ' status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()
